weather_report:
As the clock edges toward the early morning hour, Boston lies beneath a blanket of thick humidity where the atmosphere feels heavy yet oddly inviting. A subtle chance of rain lingers, whispering promises of thunderstorms that might rattle the night. The temperature hovers at a warm seventy-three, an echo of summer’s final breaths as a gentle southwest breeze stirs just enough to create a serene tranquility. The sky, mostly obscured by clouds, maintains a murky softness—ideal for nocturnal wanderings or gentle reflection while the city hums with its late-night energy.

Come dawn, the city will awaken to a slight chance of lingering showers, soon giving way to pockets of sunshine that will invite the bold-hearted back outside. The forecast hints at a high near eighty-nine, where warmth can be embraced but not without caution. Attire that breathes would be prudent—light fabrics and comfortable shoes might lead one to a leisurely stroll along the waterfront or perhaps a quiet seat in the shade of a café, indulging in a fresh pastry with a good book. In all, expect a day that invites simple pleasure without the clutter of excessive activity, a just-right day for exploration or quiet engagement with the ever-pulsing heart of Boston.
